entries.clue: & 20ac.What many an oldie will lose with Bury on fire: settlement (6,4)

annotation.definition: What many an oldie will lose

blocks.note: cross-reference: the answer continues in 20 across
w = with, as in w/
to inter is to bury
fuel is what goes on a fire
settling a bill is paying it

annotation.surface: Pensioners face losses as the Lancashire town of Bury goes up in flames.
annotation.walkthrough: The Winter Fuel Payment is a UK benefit for pensioners to help with heating, which the 2024 government withdrew from most of them. Bury looks like the town but is the verb.
annotation.definitionFit: When the payment was means-tested in 2024, most older people lost it.

entries.clue: The nation used to be all over the French (5)
